facts.title: asparagus and egg salad with walnuts and mint
ingredients: 1/2 cup (1 ounce or 30 grams) grated parmesan cheese
1/2 cup (2 ounces or 55 grams) finely chopped lightly well-toasted walnuts
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 pound asparagus, any thickness, tough ends trimmed
1/4 cup lightly packed fresh mint leaves, chopped
facts.author: Deb Perelman
